statement: Reasonix designates an append-only events JSONL file as transcript authority and keeps derived context, event-index, display-index, conflict, checkpoint, and job artifacts in separate sidecars.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix 将 append-only events JSONL 指定为 transcript authority，并把派生的 context、event index、display index、conflict、checkpoint 与 job artifacts 放在独立 sidecars 中。
display_text.en: Reasonix designates an append-only events JSONL file as transcript authority and keeps derived context, event-index, display-index, conflict, checkpoint, and job artifacts in separate sidecars.

notes: The project has not yet imported a Reasonix native trace or tested crash-tail repair.
